prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create ONE SQUARE 2x2 atlas with four equal square cells for an adult vocabulary app. Attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: restrained ink-and-watercolor educational illustrations, clear dark blue-charcoal outlines, pale blue wash, small warm natural color accents. Pure WHITE opaque background. Central 75% of each quadrant contains its subject with generous margins. Nothing crosses midlines. Leave horizontal 45–55% and vertical 47–53% center bands EMPTY WHITE. Natural human anatomy, recognizable objects, clear 320px silhouettes, restrained detail, no elaborate environment. NO captions, labels, writing, borders, grid lines, watermarks or logos. Only symbols or numerals explicitly requested in a cell are allowed. Meanings are guidance; never write them. Row-major fixed order. FOUR CELLS:
TOP LEFT — fossil man (a.化石人): An excavated fossil human skull partly embedded in earth beside a brush; archaeological remains, not a living caveman.
TOP RIGHT — recount (v.叙述): An elderly traveller recounts a sea voyage to a listening child; small thought vignette of a sailboat.
BOTTOM LEFT — saga (n.英雄故事): An open storybook with a Viking longship and shield-bearing heroic traveller rising as a small imaginary vignette.
BOTTOM RIGHT — legend (n.传说，传奇): A storyteller with listeners, imagining a knight facing a friendly dragon in mist.
CROP SAFETY: each scene occupies at most 65% of its quadrant, ample WHITE margins. Top scenes end above 45% total height. Bottom scenes start below 58% height; even heads and thought bubbles. Sparse detail, no text except explicitly requested numeric measurement. Never cross midlines.
review_notes: Inspected full atlas: subjects match planned senses, anatomy and four crop boundaries acceptable. Acre cell scheduled for replacement to remove target word and express approximate area.
